alga-2026-0002797: GET /api/v1/schedules documented the generic WorkV1ListQuery placeholders (page, limit, sort, order, fields, search, query), which listScheduleEntries() never read; the spec now documents the parsed filters (start_date, end_date, user_id). Clients sending the old params still get 200 (they were and remain ignored).

alga-2026-0002797: /api/v1/schedules/search now serves schedule entries (searchScheduleEntries) instead of the time-sheet list, so the time-sheet sort/order/fields/search/query params no longer apply; the spec documents what the handler parses (page, limit, start_date, end_date, user_id).
alga-2026-0002797: the route is now wired to the schedule-entry controller, so the documented route/controller mismatch it flagged is fixed.
